name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Centralised portal for central/state/UT scholarship schemes with application, verification, and DBT.
eligibility: Students meeting scheme-specific criteria (merit, income, category, institution).
benefits: Single-window scholarships; direct benefit transfer to bank account.
office_locator_info: Institution Nodal Officers; state scholarship departments.

faq.q: Can I apply to multiple schemes?
faq.a: Only one central scheme at a time generally; multiple where permitted.

ai_summary: NSP is a one-stop portal for government scholarships with online apply and DBT to students.
ai_explanation: The National Scholarship Portal unifies central, state, and UT scholarship schemes. Students register, find eligible schemes, apply with documents, and receive funds via DBT after institute and nodal verification. Renewal is annual.

Submitting low-resolution or oversized document scans.
Selecting the wrong state/district or service category.
Not saving the application/reference number after submission.
